data.action: 温室钢琴旁弹完旋律向镜头点头，捧花里藏着给妹妹的花
data.description: 【学校温室音乐室·午后】玛夏穿着暖白婚纱坐在钢琴旁，浅棕卷发从头纱两侧落下，捧花里夹着一枚妹妹喜欢的花朵；她弹完一小段旋律后向镜头点头，笑容像一封写给家人的信。
data.lighting: warm afternoon light through glass and leaves
data.location: greenhouse music room at the academy
data.mood: 把照顾家人的心意写成花嫁
data.promptProse: Maria sits beside the piano in the school greenhouse music room, finishing a short melody before nodding gently toward the camera. Her warm-white bridal gown and soft veil frame light-brown curls, and the bouquet includes a flower favored by her sister. The vertical medium-full view keeps piano keys and gown together. Afternoon light through glass and leaves touches pearl buttons and bouquet petals, shading the keyboard beneath her fingers.
data.title: 玛夏 · 温室钢琴旁的温柔花嫁
